quranTranslation.text: And your Lord hath said: Pray unto Me and I will hear your prayer. Lo! those who scorn My service, they will enter hell, disgraced.

explanation.bs: „Zovite Mene, Ja ću vam se odazvati“ – dova Allahu.
explanation.en: “Pray unto Me and I will hear your prayer” — supplication to Allah.

quranTranslation.text: (O mankind!) Call upon your Lord humbly and in secret. Lo! He loveth not aggressors.

explanation.bs: „Zovite svoga Gospodara ponizno i potajno“ – dova ne traži povišen glas.
explanation.en: “Call upon your Lord humbly and in secret” — duʿāʾ needs no raised voice.

quranTranslation.text: Say (unto mankind): Cry unto Allah, or cry unto the Beneficent, unto whichsoever ye cry (it is the same). His are the most beautiful names. And thou (Muhammad), be not loud-voiced in thy worship nor yet silent therein, but follow a way between.

explanation.bs: „Zovite Allaha, ili Svemilosnog zovite“ – دَعَا s imenom onoga koga se zove, kako ar-Rāġib i opisuje.
explanation.en: “Cry unto Allah, or cry unto the Beneficent” — دَعَا with the name of the one called, as ar-Rāġib describes it.

quranTranslation.text: And the dwellers of the Garden cry unto the dwellers of the Fire: We have found that which our Lord promised us (to be) the Truth. Have ye (too) found that which your Lord promised the Truth? They say: Yea, verily. And a crier in between them crieth: The curse of Allah is on evil-doers,

explanation.bs: Stanovnici Dženneta doviknu stanovnicima vatre – dozivanje preko onoga što dvije skupine razdvaja.
explanation.en: The companions of Paradise call out to the companions of the Fire — calling across what separates the two groups.

quranTranslation.text: And (mention) Dhu'n-Nun, when he went off in anger and deemed that We had no power over him, but he cried out in the darkness, saying: There is no Allah save Thee. Be Thou Glorified! Lo! I have been a wrong-doer.

explanation.bs: Junus je iz tmina zazvao: „Nema boga osim Tebe“ – nidāʾ za usrdnu dovu iz nevolje, ne nužno za daljinu.
explanation.en: Jonah cried out in the darkness: “There is no Allah save Thee” — nidāʾ for an urgent supplication in distress, not necessarily distance.

quranTranslation.text: When he cried unto his Lord a cry in secret,

explanation.bs: Zekerijja je Gospodara zazvao „potajnim zovom“ – riječ za glasno dozivanje uz tišinu; tefsir kaže da je dovu sakrio od ljudi.
explanation.en: Zechariah cried unto his Lord “a cry in secret” — a word for calling aloud joined to secrecy; tafsir says he hid his prayer from people.

quranTranslation.text: In their hearts is a disease, and Allah increaseth their disease. A painful doom is theirs because they lie.

explanation.bs: „U njihovim srcima je bolest, pa im je Allah bolest povećao“ – licemjerje kao bolest.
explanation.en: “In their hearts is a disease, and Allah increaseth their disease” — hypocrisy as disease.

quranTranslation.text: O ye wives of the Prophet! Ye are not like any other women. If ye keep your duty (to Allah), then be not soft of speech, lest he in whose heart is a disease aspire (to you), but utter customary speech.

explanation.bs: „…da ne bi zažudio onaj u čijem je srcu bolest“ – bolest srca kao strast.
explanation.en: “…lest he in whose heart is a disease aspire (to you)” — the heart's disease as desire.

quranTranslation.text: Is there in their hearts a disease, or have they doubts, or fear they lest Allah and His messenger should wrong them in judgment? Nay, but such are evil-doers.

explanation.bs: „Zar je u njihovim srcima bolest, ili sumnjaju…?“ – bolest uz sumnju.
explanation.en: “Is there in their hearts a disease, or have they doubts…?” — disease beside doubt.

quranTranslation.text: (Fast) a certain number of days; and (for) him who is sick among you, or on a journey, (the same) number of other days; and for those who can afford it there is a ransom: the feeding of a man in need - but whoso doeth good of his own accord, it is better for him: and that ye fast is better for you if ye did but know -

explanation.bs: „Onaj od vas ko se razboli ili bude na putovanju, neka (posti) isti broj drugih dana“ – tjelesna bolest i olakšica.
explanation.en: “…and (for) him who is sick among you, or on a journey, (the same) number of other days” — bodily illness and an allowance.

quranTranslation.text: No blame is there upon the blind nor any blame upon the lame nor any blame upon the sick nor on yourselves if ye eat from your houses, or the houses of your fathers, or the houses of your mothers, or the houses of your brothers, or the houses of your sisters, or the houses of your fathers' brothers, or the houses of your fathers' sisters, or the houses of your mothers' brothers, or the houses of your mothers' sisters, or (from that) whereof ye hold the keys, or (from the house) of a friend. No sin shall it be for you whether ye eat together or apart. But when ye enter houses, salute one another with a greeting from Allah, blessed and sweet. Thus Allah maketh clear His revelations for you, that haply ye may understand.

explanation.bs: „Nema zamjerke … ni bolesniku“ – olakšica bolesniku.
explanation.en: “No blame is there upon … the sick” — an allowance for the sick.

quranTranslation.text: There is no blame for the blind, nor is there blame for the lame, nor is there blame for the sick (that they go not forth to war). And whoso obeyeth Allah and His messenger, He will make him enter Gardens underneath which rivers flow; and whoso turneth back, him will He punish with a painful doom.

explanation.bs: „…ni na bolesniku nema zamjerke“ ako izostane iz boja.
explanation.en: “…nor is there blame for the sick” if he stays behind from battle.

quranTranslation.text: Then said: Lo! I feel sick!

explanation.bs: Ibrahim: „Ja sam, zaista, bolestan“ – ar-Rāġib navodi više čitanja: aluzija, prošla ili buduća bolest, ili mala bolest.
explanation.en: Abraham: “Lo! I feel sick!” — ar-Rāġib gives several readings: an allusion, a past or coming illness, or a slight one.

quranTranslation.text: Then We cast him on a desert shore while he was sick;

explanation.bs: „Pa smo ga izbacili na golu obalu, a bio je bolestan“ – tjelesna bolest; mnogi mufesiri dodaju da je bio slab i iznuren.
explanation.en: “Then We cast him on a desert shore while he was sick” — bodily illness; many mufassirun add that he was weak and worn.

quranTranslation.text: And whoso taketh Allah and His messenger and those who believe for guardian (will know that), lo! the party of Allah, they are the victorious.

explanation.bs: „Allahova stranka – oni su doista pobjednici“ – ar-Rāġib: Allahovi pomagači.
explanation.en: “Lo! the party of Allah, they are the victorious” — ar-Rāġib: Allah's helpers.

quranTranslation.text: The devil hath engrossed them and so hath caused them to forget remembrance of Allah. They are the devil's party. Lo! is it not the devil's party who will be the losers?

explanation.bs: „Oni su šejtanova stranka. Zaista, šejtanova stranka je ta koja gubi.“
explanation.en: “They are the devil's party. Lo! is it not the devil's party who will be the losers?”

quranTranslation.text: And when the true believers saw the clans, they said: This is that which Allah and His messenger promised us. Allah and His messenger are true. It did but confirm them in their faith and resignation.

explanation.bs: „A kad su vjernici ugledali saveznike (الْأَحْزَاب)…“ – skupine okupljene za borbu protiv Poslanika.
explanation.en: “And when the true believers saw the clans (الْأَحْزَاب)…” — the groups gathered to fight the Prophet.

quranTranslation.text: And thus We have inspired in thee a Lecture in Arabic, that thou mayst warn the mother-town and those around it, and mayst warn of a day of assembling whereof there is no doubt. A host will be in the Garden, and a host of them in the Flame.

explanation.bs: „Jedna skupina bit će u Džennetu, a druga skupina u plamenu“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “A host will be in the Garden, and a host of them in the Flame” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And lo! there is a party of them who distort the Scripture with their tongues, that ye may think that what they say is from the Scripture, when it is not from the Scripture. And they say: It is from Allah, when it is not from Allah; and they speak a lie concerning Allah knowingly.

explanation.bs: „Među njima je zaista skupina (فَرِيقًا) koja uvija jezike čitajući Knjigu“ – jedna skupina izdvojena od ostalih.
explanation.en: “And lo! there is a party (فَرِيقًا) of them who distort the Scripture with their tongues” — one group singled out from the rest.

quranTranslation.text: And the believers should not all go out to fight. Of every troop of them, a party only should go forth, that they (who are left behind) may gain sound knowledge in religion, and that they may warn their folk when they return to them, so that they may beware.

explanation.bs: „Zašto iz svake njihove zajednice (فِرْقَة) ne bi krenuo po jedan dio (طَائِفَة), da bi stekli razumijevanje u vjeri?“ – dio od cjeline; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Of every troop (فِرْقَة) of them, a party (طَائِفَة) only should go forth, that they (who are left behind) may gain sound knowledge in religion” — a part of a whole; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And if two parties of believers fall to fighting, then make peace between them. And if one party of them doeth wrong to the other, fight ye that which doeth wrong till it return unto the ordinance of Allah; then, if it return, make peace between them justly, and act equitably. Lo! Allah loveth the equitable.

explanation.bs: „Ako se dvije skupine vjernika međusobno zarate, uspostavite mir među njima“ – dva dijela iste zajednice.
explanation.en: “And if two parties of believers fall to fighting, then make peace between them” — two parts of one community.

quranTranslation.text: And lo! of his persuasion verily was Abraham

explanation.bs: „A od njegovih sljedbenika bio je, zaista, Ibrahim“ – po većini mufesira, Nuhovih: istog puta i vjere.
explanation.en: “And lo! of his persuasion verily was Abraham” — by most mufassirun, Noah's: of the same way and faith.

quranTranslation.text: And he entered the city at a time of carelessness of its folk, and he found therein two men fighting, one of his own caste, and the other of his enemies; and he who was of his caste asked him for help against him who was of his enemies. So Moses struck him with his fist and killed him. He said: This is of the devil's doing. Lo! he is an enemy, a mere misleader.

explanation.bs: Musa zateče dvojicu kako se tuku: „ovaj od njegovih sljedbenika, a onaj od njegovih neprijatelja“ – pristaša nasuprot neprijatelju.
explanation.en: Moses found two men fighting, “one of his own caste, and the other of his enemies” — a follower as against a foe.

quranTranslation.text: Of those who split up their religion and became schismatics, each sect exulting in its tenets.

explanation.bs: „Od onih koji su svoju vjeru rascijepili i postali sljedbe (شِيَعًا) – svaka stranka (حِزْب) raduje se onim što ima.“
explanation.en: “Of those who split up their religion and became schismatics (شِيَعًا), each sect (حِزْب) exulting in its tenets.”

quranTranslation.text: Thee (alone) we worship; Thee (alone) we ask for help.

explanation.bs: „Samo Tebi ibadet činimo i samo Tebe za pomoć molimo“ – ibadet pripada samo Allahu.
explanation.en: “Thee (alone) we worship; Thee (alone) we ask for help” — worship belongs to Allah alone.

quranTranslation.text: O mankind! worship your Lord, Who hath created you and those before you, so that ye may ward off (evil).

explanation.bs: „Ljudi, činite ibadet svome Gospodaru“ – ibadet po izboru, koji je naređen.
explanation.en: “O mankind! worship your Lord” — worship by choice, the kind that is commanded.

quranTranslation.text: Thy Lord hath decreed, that ye worship none save Him, and (that ye show) kindness to parents. If one of them or both of them attain old age with thee, say not "Fie" unto them nor repulse them, but speak unto them a gracious word.

explanation.bs: „Tvoj Gospodar je odredio da ne činite ibadet nikome osim Njemu“ – ar-Rāġib: zato što ga zaslužuje samo Allah.
explanation.en: “Thy Lord hath decreed, that ye worship none save Him” — ar-Rāġib: because only Allah deserves it.

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! Obey Allah, and obey the messenger and those of you who are in authority; and if ye have a dispute concerning any matter, refer it to Allah and the messenger if ye are (in truth) believers in Allah and the Last Day. That is better and more seemly in the end.

explanation.bs: „Pokoravajte se Allahu, i Poslaniku se pokoravajte, i onima među vama koji imaju vlast“ – pokornost i ljudima, za razliku od ibadeta.
explanation.en: “Obey Allah, and obey the messenger and those of you who are in authority” — obedience to people too, unlike worship.

quranTranslation.text: Whoso obeyeth the messenger hath obeyed Allah, and whoso turneth away: We have not sent thee as a warder over them.

explanation.bs: „Ko se pokori Poslaniku, pokorio se Allahu“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Whoso obeyeth the messenger hath obeyed Allah” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: We have enjoined on man kindness to parents; but if they strive to make thee join with Me that of which thou hast no knowledge, then obey them not. Unto Me is your return and I shall tell you what ye used to do.

explanation.bs: „A ako se budu trudili da Meni pripišeš druga o kome nemaš znanja, ti im se ne pokoravaj“ – granica pokornosti roditeljima.
explanation.en: “But if they strive to make thee join with Me that of which thou hast no knowledge, then obey them not” — the limit of obedience to parents.

quranTranslation.text: Rather prostrate yourselves before Allah and serve Him.

explanation.bs: „Zato činite sedždu Allahu i Njemu ibadet činite!“ – ar-Rāġib: svojevoljna sedžda, za koju je nagrada.
explanation.en: “Rather prostrate yourselves before Allah and serve Him” — ar-Rāġib: prostration by choice, which is rewarded.

quranTranslation.text: And unto Allah falleth prostrate whosoever is in the heavens and the earth, willingly or unwillingly, as do their shadows in the morning and the evening hours.

explanation.bs: „Allahu čini sedždu (pokorava se) svako na nebesima i na Zemlji, htio to ili ne, pa i njihove sjene“ – ar-Rāġib: sedžda pokornosti.
explanation.en: “And unto Allah falleth prostrate whosoever is in the heavens and the earth, willingly or unwillingly, as do their shadows” — ar-Rāġib: the prostration of subjection.

quranTranslation.text: And unto Allah maketh prostration whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth of living creatures, and the angels (also) and they are not proud.

explanation.bs: „Allahu čini sedždu sve na nebesima i sve na Zemlji od bića koja se kreću, pa i meleki, i oni se ne uzoholjuju“ – ar-Rāġib: obje vrste sedžde u jednom ajetu.
explanation.en: “And unto Allah maketh prostration whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth of living creatures, and the angels (also) and they are not proud” — ar-Rāġib: both kinds in one ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Establish worship, pay the poor-due, and bow your heads with those who bow (in worship).

explanation.bs: „…i činite ruku' s onima koji ruku' čine“ – mnogi mufessiri: ruku' u namazu s onima koji klanjaju.
explanation.en: “…and bow your heads with those who bow (in worship)” — many mufassirun: bowing in prayer with the worshippers.

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! Bow down and prostrate yourselves, and worship your Lord, and do good, that haply ye may prosper.

explanation.bs: „O vi koji vjerujete, činite ruku' i sedždu i ibadet činite svome Gospodaru“ – oba položaja jedan za drugim.
explanation.en: “O ye who believe! Bow down and prostrate yourselves, and worship your Lord” — the two postures one after the other.

quranTranslation.text: When it is said unto them: Bow down, they bow not down!

explanation.bs: „A kad im se kaže: Činite ruku'! – oni ruku' ne čine“ – odbijaju naredbu da ruku' učine.
explanation.en: “When it is said unto them: Bow down, they bow not down!” — they refuse the command to bow.

quranTranslation.text: And when We did appoint for Moses thirty nights (of solitude), and added to them ten, and he completed the whole time appointed by his Lord of forty nights; and Moses said unto his brother, Aaron: Take my place among the people. Do right, and follow not the way of mischief-makers.

explanation.bs: „I Musau smo odredili trideset noći, a upotpunili smo ih s još deset, pa se navršio rok njegova Gospodara – četrdeset noći“ – broj kojem više ništa ne treba; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And when We did appoint for Moses thirty nights (of solitude), and added to them ten (وَأَتْمَمْنَاهَا بِعَشْرٍ), and he completed the whole time appointed by his Lord of forty nights” — a number needing nothing more; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Perform the pilgrimage and the visit (to Makka) for Allah. And if ye are prevented, then send such gifts as can be obtained with ease, and shave not your heads until the gifts have reached their destination. And whoever among you is sick or hath an ailment of the head must pay a ransom of fasting or almsgiving or offering. And if ye are in safety, then whosoever contenteth himself with the visit for the pilgrimage (shall give) such gifts as can be had with ease. And whosoever cannot find (such gifts), then a fast of three days while on the pilgrimage, and of seven when ye have returned; that is, ten in all. That is for him whoso folk are not present at the Inviolable Place of Worship. Observe your duty to Allah, and know that Allah is severe in punishment.

explanation.bs: „I upotpunite, Allaha radi, hadž i umru.“
explanation.en: “Perform (وَأَتِمُّوا) the pilgrimage and the visit (to Makka) for Allah.”

quranTranslation.text: The month of Ramadan in which was revealed the Qur'an, a guidance for mankind, and clear proofs of the guidance, and the Criterion (of right and wrong). And whosoever of you is present, let him fast the month, and whosoever of you is sick or on a journey, (let him fast the same) number of other days. Allah desireth for you ease; He desireth not hardship for you; and (He desireth) that ye should complete the period, and that ye should magnify Allah for having guided you, and that peradventure ye may be thankful.

explanation.bs: „… i da biste broj (dana) usavršili i veličali Allaha zato što vas je uputio.“
explanation.en: “… that ye should complete the period (وَلِتُكْمِلُوا الْعِدَّةَ), and that ye should magnify Allah for having guided you.”

quranTranslation.text: And those who believe and do good works: such are rightful owners of the Garden. They will abide therein.

explanation.bs: „… takvi pripadaju Džennetu i u njemu će trajno ostati.“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet: u Džennetu stvari ostaju kakve jesu, bez kvarenja.
explanation.en: “such are rightful owners of the Garden. They will abide therein.” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah: in the Garden things remain as they are, without decay.

quranTranslation.text: We appointed immortality for no mortal before thee. What! if thou diest, can they be immortal!

explanation.bs: „Nijednom čovjeku prije tebe nismo dali besmrtnost …“ – na ovom svijetu niko ne ostaje.
explanation.en: “We appointed immortality for no mortal before thee.” — in this world no one remains.

quranTranslation.text: Say: Is that (doom) better or the Garden of Immortality which is promised unto those who ward off (evil)? It will be their reward and journey's end.

explanation.bs: „… ili Džennet besmrtnosti koji je obećan bogobojaznima …“ – trajnost kao ime Dženneta.
explanation.en: “or the Garden of Immortality which is promised unto those who ward off (evil)” — lastingness as the Garden's name.

quranTranslation.text: And the first to lead the way, of the Muhajirin and the Ansar, and those who followed them in goodness - Allah is well pleased with them and they are well pleased with Him, and He hath made ready for them Gardens underneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide for ever. That is the supreme triumph.

explanation.bs: „… i pripremio im je vrtove ispod kojih teku rijeke; u njima će ostajati, i to zauvijek …“ – خَالِد i أَبَدًا zajedno: boravak, i to da mu nema kraja.
explanation.en: “He hath made ready for them Gardens underneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide for ever.” — خَالِد and أَبَدًا together: the stay, and that it has no end.

quranTranslation.text: And he went into his garden, while he (thus) wronged himself. He said: I think not that all this will ever perish.

explanation.bs: „… Ne mislim da će ovo ikada propasti.“ – uz negaciju: vlasnik bašče mislio je da je njegovo dobro trajno, a ono je uništeno (18:42).
explanation.en: “I think not that all this will ever perish.” — with a negation: the owner of the garden thought his wealth would last, and it was destroyed (18:42).
